authority: T0 exact claim-nonbearing fixed-regulator classical splitting, routed-seam, and invariant-state route-split theorem; not a TECT action, physical candidate selection, autonomous-flow identity, common regular stationary-state theorem, CP1 completion, C6 advancement, or Pre-A closure
statement: On the inserted one-dimensional per-unit-transverse-area CL8 regulator, replace the previously inserted passive controller by two exact bond-potential half-kicks separated by inherited kinetic drift. The resulting symmetric two-substep bond macro is a controller-free global polynomial symplectomorphism. Away from zero coupling/step and one exact step resonance, all four complete-leg mixed projections have explicit global inverses. The cross determinants are rho^16 and (1-rho^2)^8, independent of the nonlinear onsite Hessian. The same local rule gives controller-free reconstruction of every open acyclic monotone cut and carries each periodic bond potential and half-owned endpoint kinetic coefficient exactly once under the even/odd ledger. A quotient audit rejects direct raw fixed-site EO equality. For every square k by k quotient, an explicit permutation table instead gives an exact swap-dressed straight-routing seam-frame conjugacy; k=3 is the first raw-routing counterexample. Singular fixed-point probabilities and a conditional one-bond quadratic shadow exist, but an admitted C4 hyperbolic tangent refutes a universal positive-quadratic invariant, tangent-circuit Gaussian, or zero-centred nonlinear Gaussian theorem on the full mixed-inverse domain. It does not exclude an arbitrary off-centre nonlinear stationary Gaussian. The macro remains a symmetric second-order splitting companion, not the exact autonomous CL8 flow. A common regular state/reference/counterterm ledger, the one-dimensional-to-three-dimensional Q3 bridge, and regulator removal remain open.
verdict: ADVANCE THE CONTROLLER-FREE GLOBAL MIXED MACRO, OPEN-ACYCLIC-ALL-CUT BRIDGE, EXACT ALL-K SWAP-DRESSED ROUTED SEAM CONJUGACY, SINGULAR EQUILIBRIUM STATES, AND CONDITIONAL ONE-BOND QUADRATIC SHADOW; REJECT RAW RECTANGLE-EQUALS-EO IDENTIFICATION AND A UNIVERSAL PERIODIC POSITIVE-QUADRATIC, TANGENT-GAUSSIAN, OR ZERO-CENTRED NONLINEAR-GAUSSIAN THEOREM ON THE FULL ADMITTED DOMAIN; KEEP ARBITRARY OFF-CENTRE GAUSSIANS, COMMON REGULAR STATE/REFERENCE, 1D-TO-3D, CONTINUUM, CP1, C6, AND PRE-A OPEN

model_scope.parameter_domain: M even and M>=4, L>0, a=L/M, w=a/8, mu=chi*w, chi>0, c>0, g>0, lambda>0, real r, and nonzero Delta with rho^2!=1

macro_definition.Strang_identity: M_Delta=S_(Delta/2)^2 for the bond Hamiltonian, where each S is one symmetric Strang substep

exact_mixed_inverse.intermediate_notation: x1=x+h*p/mu, y1=y+h*r/mu, P1 and R1 after kick one, x2=x1+2h*P1/mu, y2=y1+2h*R1/mu, P2 and R2 after kick two, E=(x2+h*P2/mu,P2), N=(y2+h*R2/mu,R2)
exact_mixed_inverse.other_orientations: leg exchange gives the two remaining mixed orientations
exact_mixed_inverse.noncommutativity_firewall: No commutation of the two onsite Hessians is assumed. The block elimination uses the ordered Schur identity D*A-beta*C=(1-rho^2)I, not an illegally reordered product.

exact_flow_consistency_lemma.mass_firewall: For the exact bond flow the standard kinetic mass is m=2*mu, not mu.
exact_flow_consistency_lemma.scope: Every compact phase set has a sufficiently small nonzero time interval with local mixed inverses. This does not prove a global exact-flow mixed inverse or exclude caustics.
exact_flow_consistency_lemma.macro_comparison: The macro species-leading factor is kappa^2*Delta^4/(64*mu^2), whereas exact flow gives kappa^2*Delta^4/(48*mu^2); this confirms that M_Delta is an integrator, not the exact flow.

symplectic_and_term_ledger.symplecticity: Every drift and kick is an exact global polynomial symplectomorphism, so det D M_Delta=1 and M_Delta^(-1)=M_(-Delta).
symplectic_and_term_ledger.bond_potential_ownership: two kicks give 2s=Delta, exactly one Delta occurrence of V on that bond
symplectic_and_term_ledger.bond_kinetic_ownership: four full-node drift parameters give 4h=Delta/2 per endpoint, exactly the time-Delta flow coefficient of the half-owned endpoint kinetic ||p||^2/(4*mu)
symplectic_and_term_ledger.periodic_ledger: on an even periodic ring, the even and odd bond sets partition all bonds and every node belongs to exactly two bonds; hence every potential bond and every full-node kinetic coefficient occurs exactly once per declared period
symplectic_and_term_ledger.accuracy_boundary: the bond macro is symmetric second order with local error O_K(Delta^3); an even-then-odd periodic product is a controller-free first-order consistent Floquet companion unless an additional symmetric layer composition is declared

open_rectangle_result.domain: an open directed m by n acyclic rectangle with m,n positive and m+n=M
open_rectangle_result.local_rule: place the same M_Delta at every vertex
open_rectangle_result.result: every monotone order-ideal cut contains M complete legs and is related to the incoming arms by a global polynomial symplectic diffeomorphism; temporal and complementary mixed reconstruction are exact and sweep independent
open_rectangle_result.scope_boundary: this result covers open acyclic monotone cuts only; no wrapped seam, cylinder quotient, or periodic monodromy is inferred

periodic_quotient_audit.quotient: Gamma=Z^2/<T> with T=(m,-n), m,n>0, and M=m+n
periodic_quotient_audit.acyclic_height: theta([i,j])=n*i+m*j is well defined and rises by n on east edges and m on north edges, so the directed quotient has no cycle
periodic_quotient_audit.block_cut: B has word S^n E^m and B1=B+(m,0); the transfer contains m*n macro vertices
periodic_quotient_audit.incidence: every horizontal row wire meets every vertical column wire once, hence the occurrence graph is K_(n,m), with horizontal degree m and vertical degree n
periodic_quotient_audit.seam_rotation: in a seam-fixed cyclic frame the output cut is R^n B, and R^n has order M/gcd(m,n)
periodic_quotient_audit.parity: checkerboard parity descends exactly when M is even; R^n preserves the even/odd bond colour exactly when n is even
periodic_quotient_audit.raw_ring_comparison: one raw fixed-site even/odd ring period has incidence C_M, M gates, and degree two. Incidence and count agreement force m=n=2.
periodic_quotient_audit.exact_C4_survivor: for m=n=2, writing A=M_(H1,V1), B=M_(H1,V2), C=M_(H2,V1), D=M_(H2,V2), U_block=D*C*B*A, F=(D*A)*(B*C), and C_cut=A, disjoint-gate commutation gives C_cut*U_block=F*C_cut exactly
periodic_quotient_audit.direct_equality_counterexample: at a=1,c=8,chi=8,Delta=2,r=0 with positive g and lambda, rho=1/2 and the declared rational one-species tangent sends q_H1 to (-5/8,-1/2,1,-1,7/8,-1/2,3/4,2) under U_block but to (-5/8,-1/2,7/8,3/2,-1/8,-1/2,7/8,-1/2) under the matching raw EO circuit
periodic_quotient_audit.general_square_theorem: for m=n=k, let G_(j,i)=M_(H_j,V_i), let C_k be the diagonal-ordered triangle i+j<=k, and let L_l be the disjoint matching G_(j,[l-j]_k). Trace-monoid projection gives C_k*U_k=(L_k*...*L_1)*C_k for every k. In the existing straight routing, the geometric local gate is P after M and the explicit slot table pos_r(H_j)=2(k-j)+r, pos_r(V_i)=2(i-1)+1-r gives C_ring*U_k*C_ring^(-1)=R^(-k)*Fhat_k exactly.
periodic_quotient_audit.general_square_checks: exact rational checks pass for k=2,3,4, including every routed layer, total frame, half-turn, intertwiner and seam-fixed conjugacy; raw routing first fails at k=3
periodic_quotient_audit.negative_conclusion: the seam-fixed straight-routed rectangle quotient is not the raw fixed-site even/odd product of M_Delta. This does not reject the exact C4 conjugacy, a declared turning routing, a translated-edge frame, or the swap-dressed geometric circuit.

invariant_state_route_split.singular_positive_states: delta at the all-zero phase is stationary on every macro cut. For r<0, the globally correlated one-half mixture of the all-plus-v and all-minus-v fixed phases, v=sqrt(-r/g), is also an exact normalized stationary classical probability.

The full zero-phase 32 by 32 bond tangent is exactly eight decoupled identical species blocks.
invariant_state_route_split.periodic_C4_obstruction: at the admitted rho=1/2 tangent, in C4 order (q_H1,p_H1,q_H2,p_H2,q_V1,p_V1,q_V2,p_V2) with F=(D*A)*(B*C) acting right-to-left, the characteristic polynomial is (z-1)^2(z^2+z+1)(z^2+3z+1)^2, giving reciprocal real hyperbolic eigenvalues. Therefore no positive-definite quadratic invariant or nondegenerate Gaussian for the tangent circuit exists. For the full nonlinear fixture, no C2 invariant with a strict nondegenerate minimum at zero, hence no zero-centred invariant Gaussian, exists. An arbitrary off-centre nonlinear stationary Gaussian is not excluded. Exact C4 conjugacy transfers only these scoped obstructions to the routed block.
